notes: The npm package remains on the 1.x release line while exposing the preview V2 API under /v2.
The JS build generates openapi.json temporarily and removes it after SDK generation.
The upstream build patches SSE generic output and selected generated query scalar types.

rust_generation.scope: operation manifest and pinned contract validation for the legacy/current and V2 preview vertical slices

evaluated.openapi-generator-rust: Rejected for whole-document model generation: current feature matrix reports no anyOf/union/null support required by this OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
evaluated.progenitor-0.15.0: Rejected for whole-document generation in this slice: its documented input target is OpenAPI 3.0.x while OpenCode emits OpenAPI 3.1.

sse.note: Legacy/current events are JSON-decoded by the ergonomic stream. V2 preview streams retain raw SSE data for forward compatibility while the durable-event union evolves.
